items.title: 52145_Andrew Blakeney oral history interview
items.q: at the time when Duke Ellington came out there and played a short time and we followed them.

ctx.x: Gardena, California. Was that the club where they had the famous chorus line and all these dancing girls?

That's right. Blufield and Greeley had the floor show, because I had played with him before that at the Cotton Club back in the thirties, at the time when Duke Ellington came out there and played a short time and we followed them. / That was in 1934.
And you worked with at the Bell Tavern C.L. Burke from 1943 to 1946; is that correct?
